Applications must be submitted online on or before 31-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Guwahati to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Guwahati Project Fellow Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 31-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Guwahati to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Guwahati Project Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Project Fellow position at IIT Guwahati is 31st August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Science or a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering/Design/Humanities with 3 years of experience. Knowledge of phonetic transcription of intonation is also necessary.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Project Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 25,000 to Rs. 26,250 per month.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Project Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Fellow position at IIT Guwahati.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the IIT Guwahati Project Fellow recruitment is strictly online.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Project Fellow post?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Fellow position will be based on an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Guwahati located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati is located in Guwahati, Assam, with the pincode 781039.

faq.question: Q9. What is the nature of this job?
faq.answer: The Project Fellow position at IIT Guwahati is a contractual job.

faq.question: Q10. When is the interview scheduled for the Project Fellow position?
faq.answer: The interview for the Project Fellow position is scheduled to be held on 4th September 2026.
